import sys
import io

from pathlib import Path

import re

template_path = Path\(''storage/templates/yunnan_forestry_college_template.docx''\)
doc = Document\(str\(template_path''\)\)

# 定义正则模式 \(与 template_parser.py 中的相同\)
VARIABLE_PATTERN = re.compile\(r''\\{\\{\\s*\(\\w+\)\\s*\\}\\}''\)
LOOP_START_PATTERN = re.compile\(r''\\{%\\s*for\\s+\(\\w+\)\\s+in\\s+\(\\w+\)\\s*%\\}''\)
LOOP_END_PATTERN = re.compile\(r''\\{%\\s*endfor\\s*%\\}''\)
IF_START_PATTERN = re.compile\(r''\\{%\\s*if\\s+\(\\w+\)\\s*%\\}''\)
IF_END_PATTERN = re.compile\(r''\\{%\\s*endif\\s*%\\}''\)

fields = []

# 统计所有标签
for table_idx, table in enumerate\(doc.tables\):
    for row_idx, row in enumerate\(table.rows\):
        for cell_idx, cell in enumerate\(row.cells\):
            text = cell.text
            
            # 统计变量
            for match in VARIABLE_PATTERN.finditer\(text\):
                fields.append\(\(''variable'', match.group\(1\), f''T{table_idx}R{row_idx}C{cell_idx}''\)\)
            
            # 统计循环开始
            match = LOOP_START_PATTERN.search\(text\)
            if match:
                fields.append\(\(''loop_start'', match.group\(2\), f''T{table_idx}R{row_idx}C{cell_idx}''\)\)
            
            # 统计循环结束
            if LOOP_END_PATTERN.search\(text\):
                fields.append\(\(''loop_end'', '''', f''T{table_idx}R{row_idx}C{cell_idx}''\)\)
            
            # 统计 if 开始
            match = IF_START_PATTERN.search\(text\)
            if match:
                fields.append\(\(''if_start'', match.group\(1\), f''T{table_idx}R{row_idx}C{cell_idx}''\)\)
            
            # 统计 if 结束
            if IF_END_PATTERN.search\(text\):
                fields.append\(\(''if_end'', '''', f''T{table_idx}R{row_idx}C{cell_idx}''\)\)

print\(''=== 找到的所有标签 ===''\)
for field_type, name, location in fields:
    print\(f''{field_type:12} {name:30} {location}''\)

print\(''\\n=== 标签统计 ===''\)
loop_starts = [f for f in fields if f[0] == ''loop_start'']
loop_ends = [f for f in fields if f[0] == ''loop_end'']
if_starts = [f for f in fields if f[0] == ''if_start'']
if_ends = [f for f in fields if f[0] == ''if_end'']
variables = set\([f[1] for f in fields if f[0] == ''variable'']\)

print\(f''循环开始标签: {len\(loop_starts\)} 个''\)
for f in loop_starts:
    print\(f''  - {f[1]} at {f[2]}''\)

print\(f''\\n循环结束标签: {len\(loop_ends\)} 个''\)
for f in loop_ends:
    print\(f''  - at {f[2]}''\)

print\(f''\\nif 开始标签: {len\(if_starts\)} 个''\)
for f in if_starts:
    print\(f''  - {f[1]} at {f[2]}''\)

print\(f''\\nif 结束标签: {len\(if_ends\)} 个''\)
for f in if_ends:
    print\(f''  - at {f[2]}''\)

print\(f''\\n变量标签: {len\(variables\)} 个''\)
print\(f''  - {sorted\(variables\)}''\)

print\(''\\n=== 验证结果 ===''\)
if len\(loop_starts\) != len\(loop_ends\):
    print\(f''ERROR: 循环标签不匹配! start={len\(loop_starts\)}, end={len\(loop_ends\)}''\)
else:
    print\(f''OK: 循环标签匹配 \({len\(loop_starts\)} 对\)''\)

if len\(if_starts\) != len\(if_ends\):
    print\(f''ERROR: if 标签不匹配! start={len\(if_starts\)}, end={len\(if_ends\)}''\)
else:
    print\(f''OK: if 标签匹配 \({len\(if_starts\)} 对\)''\)

required_fields = {''subject'', ''grade'', ''topic'', ''duration''}
found_fields = variables
missing_fields = required_fields - found_fields
if missing_fields:
    print\(f''WARNING: 缺少必填字段: {missing_fields}''\)
else:
    print\(f''OK: 必填字段都存在''\)
")
